experiment: MIMIC-IV full v3.1 DKA ensemble robustness

selector_gate.rule: choose lowest discovery MAE per target, otherwise persistence

diagnosis_pure_subset.interpretation: This parquet is already the ICD-supported cohort; a stricter diagnosis-only subset would require adding diagnosis-code class metadata to extraction.

hospital_or_careunit_split.reason: MIMIC-IV full v3.1 parquet does not currently include careunit, hospital, or site columns. Add aggregate-safe unit metadata to the extractor before claiming hospital/careunit robustness.

interpretation: A robustness pass means the ensemble beats persistence across patient split seeds and time-order split.
This remains an observational factual proxy and does not identify treatment effects.
Hospital/careunit robustness is not tested until the extractor includes non-identifying unit metadata.
